top: The offender's race as reported upon intake.
The Indiana county in which the court that ordered the incarceration is located.
The conviction type for the most serious offense of the offender's incarceration- e.g. FA (Felony A), MA (misdemeanor a) etc.
The crime category of the Most Serious Offense
The number of sentenced days that were actually served by the offender.
The number of days sentenced in total for all convictions for a given incarceration.
The age group of the offender on the date when the offender was released either to parole or discharge for this commitment period.
The year of the date when the offender was released either to parole or discharge for this commitment period.
The age group of the offender on the date of the original intake procedure was conducted for an offender for the present period of incarceration.
The year of the original intake procedure was conducted for an offender for the present period of incarceration.
